# Interface scenes: what each script needs

A scene of the interface is a **scene and a script**. The script finds the nodes it needs **by name**, so a scene you build yourself works when it has nodes with the names the script looks for, of the types it expects. This page lists the templates the toolkit provides and, for every scene class, the nodes the script looks for, the exports to fill in and the signals it emits.

How to read it:

- **`%Name`** is a node with *Access as Unique Name* on, anywhere in the scene. **`$Name`** or **`$Path/To/Node`** is a node found by its place under the root, so moving it breaks the script.
- A node the script looks for that is not in your scene is `null` in the script, and the part that needs it does nothing. Everything else keeps working.
- Exports are filled in the inspector of the scene root (a scene to instantiate for each row, a texture).
- To build your own scene, see [Building your own interface scene](/advanced/user-interface/building-your-own). The [UI Settings](/basic/game-settings/ui-settings#the-scenes-and-their-roots) editor checks the root class of the scenes you set.

## The templates the toolkit provides

88 scenes in `res://addons/chroniclenode/`, each with the class on its root node. Copy one next to your own scenes, change it and set it in [UI Settings](/basic/game-settings/ui-settings), or start from your own scene with the same root class.

## Menus

### ArrowSelectionButton {#class-arrow-selection-button}

`ArrowSelectionButton` extends `MarginContainer` ([class page](/advanced/user-interface/menus/arrow-selection-button))

ArrowSelectionButton - Cyclic selection control with arrow navigation Supports both numeric options (1 to N) and string-based options with display names.

Script: `ui_scenes/menus/character_creation_menu/buttons/arrow_selection_button.gd`

Template scene: `ui_scenes/menus/character_creation_menu/buttons/arrow_selection_button_template.tscn`

| Node the script looks for | Type | Found as | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type_label` | `Label` | `%TypeLabel` | The type label (a Label) of the scene, found by its unique name %TypeLabel. |
| `selection_label` | `Label` | `%SelectionLabel` | The selection label (a Label) of the scene, found by its unique name %SelectionLabel. |
| `left` | `Control` | `%Left` | The left (a Control) of the scene, found by its unique name %Left. |
| `left_pressed` | `Control` | `%LeftPressed` | The left pressed (a Control) of the scene, found by its unique name %LeftPressed. |
| `right` | `Control` | `%Right` | The right (a Control) of the scene, found by its unique name %Right. |
| `right_pressed` | `Control` | `%RightPressed` | The right pressed (a Control) of the scene, found by its unique name %RightPressed. |

| Export | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `number_of_options` | `int` | How many options there are. |
| `option_labels` | `Array[String]` | Optional array of display strings for each option If empty, shows numeric values (1, 2, 3...) If populated, shows these strings instead |

Signals: `selection_changed(option: int)`

### ButtonSubMenu {#class-button-sub-menu}

`ButtonSubMenu` extends `MarginContainer` ([class page](/advanced/user-interface/menus/button-sub-menu))

A button of the settings menu that opens one of its sub menus (display, audio, controls ...): its text, with colors for the normal, the highlighted and the active state.

Script: `ui_scenes/menus/settings/settings_buttons/button_sub_menu.gd`

Template scene: `ui_scenes/menus/settings/settings_buttons/button_sub_menu_template.tscn`

| Node the script looks for | Type | Found as | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | `Button` | `$Button` | The button (a Button) of the scene, found by its path $Button. |
| `button_hover` | `TextureRect` | `%ButtonHover` | The button hover (a TextureRect) of the scene, found by its unique name %ButtonHover. |
| `border_1` | `TextureRect` | `%Border1` | The border 1 (a TextureRect) of the scene, found by its unique name %Border1. |
| `border_2` | `TextureRect` | `%Border2` | The border 2 (a TextureRect) of the scene, found by its unique name %Border2. |
| `header_label` | `Label` | `%HeaderLabel` | The header label (a Label) of the scene, found by its unique name %HeaderLabel. |

| Export | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `button_text` | `String` | The text of the button. |
| `text_normal_color` | `Color` | The color of the text. |
| `brackets_active_color` | `Color` | The color of the brackets around the text when it is the one open. |
| `text_highlight_color` | `Color` | The color of the text under the mouse. |
| `active_colour_highlight` | `Color` | The color of the button when it is the one open. |

Signals: `button_up(button: MarginContainer)`

### CharacterCreation3DScene {#class-character-creation3-d-scene}

`CharacterCreation3DScene` extends `Node3D` ([class page](/advanced/user-interface/menus/character-creation3-d-scene))

CharacterCreation3DScene - Manages the 3D character preview in character creation Handles skeleton instantiation, customization preview, and idle animations.

Script: `ui_scenes/menus/character_creation_menu/character_creation_3d_scene.gd`

| Export | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `skeleton_container` | `Node3D` | Node to parent skeletons under (uses self if not set) |
| `idle_animation_names` | `Array[String]` | Default idle animation names to try |
| `preview_camera` | `Camera3D` | Camera for the preview (optional, for rotation control) |
| `rotation_speed` | `float` | Rotation speed for preview |

Signals: `skeleton_changed(skeleton: CustomSkeleton)`, `customization_applied(definition: CustomCharacterDefinition)`

| `title_label` | `Label` | `%TitleLabel` | The title label (a Label) of the scene, found by its unique name %TitleLabel. |
| `text_label` | `RichTextLabel` | `%TextLabel` | The text label (a RichTextLabel) of the scene, found by its unique name %TextLabel. |
| `icon_rect` | `TextureRect` | `%IconRect` | The icon rect (a TextureRect) of the scene, found by its unique name %IconRect. |

### PopupUI {#class-popup-ui}

`PopupUI` extends `Control` ([class page](/advanced/user-interface/in-game/popup-ui))

The root of a popup scene.

Script: `ui_scenes/in_game/popups/popup_ui.gd`

| Export | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `close_on_escape` | `bool` | ESC closes the popup (when it is the one on top) |
| `block_gameplay_input` | `bool` | Gameplay does not react to the mouse and the keys while the popup is open (the popup itself does) |
| `pause_game` | `bool` | The game is paused while the popup is open (time stands still) |
| `show_once` | `bool` | The popup is shown once in a game (tutorials): after that it is never shown again, also not after a load. A new game shows it again |
| `when_another_is_open` | `PopupData.WhenBusy` | What to do when this popup is asked for while another popup is on the screen |

Signals: `closed(popup: PopupUI)`
